description: A nonvacuous negative-finite-cost, non-dogmatic prior model has a practical maximizer and all many-policy mixtures maximize, while the actual religious proposition is false. Distinct one and one-half act probabilities tie; omitting positive prior or positive action destroys infinite payoff. Act choice does not encode belief control. Conditional mathematical working reconstruction, not an attributed historical claim or truth-root discharge.
